```{r load-data}
load(here("data", "newest_SRS.RData"))

if (!exists("dat33")) {
  dat33 <- qza_to_phyloseq(
    features = here("data", "table_filt_decomtam33_V4.qza"),
    tree = here("data", "asvs-tree_V4.qza"),
    taxonomy = here("data", "classification.qza"),
    metadata = here("data", "metadata_dat33.txt")
  )
}
```

```{r select-study}
study <- "Gubert et al. 2022"

sub <- subset_samples(dat33, Authors == study)
sub <- subset_samples(sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))

sample_data_df <- data.frame(sample_data(sub))

sample_data_df <- sample_data_df %>%
  mutate(
    group_general = case_when(
      experimental_treatment_raw == "Water-T0" ~ "control",
      Authors == "Velasco et al. 2021" & strain == "C57BL/6J" ~ "control",
      TRUE ~ experimental_treatment_raw
    )
  )

sample_data(sub) <- sample_data(sample_data_df)
group_list <- unique(sample_data_df$group_general)
```

```{r run-aldex2}
set.seed(520)

res_all <- list()

for (group in group_list) {
  tb <- subset_samples(sub, group_general == group)
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(tb))

  valid_group <-
    length(unique(sample_df$host_sex)) > 1 &&
    sum(sample_df$host_sex == "male") > 1 &&
    sum(sample_df$host_sex == "female") > 1

  if (!valid_group) {
    message("Skipping ALDEx2 for ", group, " (insufficient male/female samples).")
    next
  }

  d_x <- aldex.clr(as.data.frame(otu_table(tb)), conds = sample_data(tb)$host_sex, mc.samples = 128)
  d_eff <- aldex.effect(d_x)
  d_tt <- aldex.ttest(d_x)

  res <- data.frame(d_eff, d_tt)
  taxa <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(tax_table(tb)), var = "Row.names")

  res_taxa <- merge(taxa, res, by = "Row.names") %>%
    mutate(
      Group = group,
      Study = study,
      direct = case_when(
        effect > 0 ~ "Positive",
        effect <= 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "NA"
      )
    )

  res_all[[group]] <- res_taxa
}

res.all <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_all)
res.all.sig <- res.all %>% filter(wi.eBH < 0.05)

write.csv(res.all, here("results", "res.all.combined.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res.all.sig, here("results", "res.all.combined.sig.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r run-ancom}
ancom_all <- list()

for (group in group_list) {
  tb <- subset_samples(sub, group_general == group)
  sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(tb))

  valid_group <-
    length(unique(sample_df$host_sex)) > 1 &&
    sum(sample_df$host_sex == "male") > 1 &&
    sum(sample_df$host_sex == "female") > 1

  if (!valid_group) {
    message("Skipping ANCOM for ", group, " (insufficient male/female samples).")
    next
  }

  rel_abun <- transform_sample_counts(tb, function(x) x / sum(x))
  remove_low_abun <- filter_taxa(rel_abun, function(x) max(x) > 0.001, TRUE)
  tb <- filter_taxa(remove_low_abun, function(x) stats::var(x) > 1e-06, TRUE)

  out <- ANCOMBC::ancom(
    data = tb,
    meta_data = sample_df,
    p_adj_method = "BH",
    prv_cut = 0.10,
    lib_cut = min(sample_sums(tb)),
    main_var = "host_sex",
    alpha = 0.05,
    n_cl = 1
  )

  res <- out$res
  q_val <- out$q_data
  beta_val <- out$beta_data

  beta_val <- beta_val * (q_val < 0.05)
  beta_pos <- apply(abs(beta_val), 2, which.max)
  beta_max <- vapply(seq_along(beta_pos), function(i) beta_val[beta_pos[i], i], FUN.VALUE = double(1))

  n_taxa <- ifelse(
    is.null(out$zero_ind),
    nrow(otu_table(tb)),
    sum(apply(out$zero_ind[, -1, drop = FALSE], 1, sum) == 0)
  )

  df_w <- res %>%
    mutate(
      beta = beta_max,
      direct = case_when(
        detected_0.7 & beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
        detected_0.7 & beta <= 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(W)

  taxa <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(tax_table(tb)), var = "Row.names")
  df_w_taxa <- merge(taxa, df_w, by = "Row.names") %>%
    mutate(group = group, Study = study)

  df_w_taxa$W <- replace(df_w_taxa$W, is.infinite(df_w_taxa$W), n_taxa - 1)
  df_w_taxa$direct <- factor(df_w_taxa$direct, levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Not Significant"))

  ancom_all[[group]] <- df_w_taxa
}

ancom.all2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(ancom_all)
ancom.all.sig2 <- ancom.all2 %>% filter(direct %in% c("Positive", "Negative"))

write.csv(ancom.all2, here("results", "ancom.all.combined_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ancom.all.sig2, here("results", "ancom.all.combined.sig_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r overlap-results}
if (nrow(res.all.sig) > 0 && nrow(ancom.all.sig2) > 0) {
  res.all.sig$id <- paste(res.all.sig$Group, res.all.sig$Study, res.all.sig$direct, sep = "_")
  ancom.all.sig2$id <- paste(ancom.all.sig2$group, ancom.all.sig2$Study, ancom.all.sig2$direct, sep = "_")

  common_ids <- intersect(res.all.sig$id, ancom.all.sig2$id)
  matching_rows_A <- res.all.sig[res.all.sig$id %in% common_ids, ]$Row.names
  matching_rows_B <- ancom.all.sig2[ancom.all.sig2$id %in% common_ids, ]$Row.names

  overlap <- intersect(matching_rows_A, matching_rows_B)
  both.sig2 <- res.all.sig[res.all.sig$Row.names %in% overlap, ]

  write.csv(both.sig2, here("results", "both.sig_sex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```
